profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
With over a dozen years of experience, Jongwook develops simple and robust software that delivers value to customers. Jongwook believes that showing the client a working software first and evolving that product together is important to the development process, so he welcomes changing requirements. He enjoys problem solving and communicating with motivated individuals.

As a full-stack developer, he can make simple and robust web apps with Python, Hack, and React. And he also has experience of various machine learning projects including information retrieval and log analysis.

Jongwook has led several teams and projects. Each team has focused on motivation and growth.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software engineer of the Instagram Creators Support Experience team.

* Led a live chat support project for IG creators and Meta Verified subscribers. Collaborated closely with a central support organization to make the system reliable and effective.
* Developed an anti-spam comment filter leveraging user behavior signals.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
The tech lead of the Right Language Experience project of the I18N team

* Designed a string extraction plugin API and supported engineers to adopt the new API.
* Developed a feature to support regional formats that users can specify their preference of number and datetime format regardless of their UI language.
* Modeled a user language prediction model using DNN based on historical switch events. Used this model to run campaigns to help users to be in the right language.
* Collaborated with product teams to improve users’ localized experience.

positions.title: Solutions Engineer
positions.description:
A solutions engineer at Facebook Korea.

* Collaborated with Ads engineers and consulted Korean advertisers to adopt and utilize Facebook marketing solutions such as Dynamic Ads, Pixel, App Events.
* Built a Thrift server to extract assets from mobile web pages.
* Built data pipelines to aggregate evaluation data from Amazon MTurk for the prediction of  Ads creatives performance.

positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.description:
A search Quality Team Lead, the rank modeler of Daum Search service and the main developer of a meta blog service.

* Implemented a blog post ranking algorithm based on bloggers’ credibility which was computed by their recommendation histories.
* Created a personalized blog post feeder on Lucene.
* Modeled news and image collection ranking algorithms.
* Led a team to create a buzz search service from scratch, which gathered and evaluatesd users’ reactions to finding issues and related content.
* Led a team that focused on developing search keyword services, including auto-completion, query suggestion, and trends.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
A tech lead of Hangame web development center and the main committer of common web framework and libraries.

* Adopted Agile methodologies to the team.
* Integrated Java frameworks such as Spring, iBatis, and FreeMarker with existing online game web services.
* Automated the server management system and the service deployment system using Bash.
* Implemented network servers to communicate with game servers and to back up authentication from Oracle servers by using a memory database instead.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed features of Cyworld, the first and the most popular  social network services in Korea.

* Implemented a common JavaScript library based on Prototype.js.
* Developed the front-end of a new service where people can create an event and communicate online.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed various features and web sites such as online photo print service, online movie, and p2p file transfer service.
